units.Description: Not stated in the release (written as n/a; BrainVision header 'unscaled'). The stored values have median absolute amplitudes of about 3e-5 to 2e-4, consistent with volts, but the release does not say so.

type.Description: SEEG for names 'POL <electrode letters><contact number>' (Nihon Kohden-style export names, kept verbatim) except 'POL Fp<n>'; EEG for 'EEG ...-Ref' and 'POL Fp<n>' (scalp electrodes); ECG for names containing ECG/EKG; MISC otherwise (e.g. 'POL E', 'POL A5A6-0', 'POL L', 'POL R'). Types are inferred from the names; the release does not list channel types.
